_comment: Bush lasher — the 'lasher': planted (never walks). Faces the player inside sight_range; inside lash_range it tells with a LONG windup, then swings a lash_size hitbox in front of itself for lash_active seconds with heavy knockback. While the swing runs it cannot be staggered or pushed (resist 1); between swings it is a soft target. Touch damage 1. Numbers in px, px/s, seconds.
